units.source_text: 源氏公子此后两三天不进宫，专心和紫儿做伴，使她稔熟起来。

en.t: For the next two or three days, Prince Genji did not go to court, but devoted himself to keeping Zi'er company so that she would grow familiar with him.

units.source_text: 他写许多字，画许多画给她看，就拿这些给她当作习字帖和画帖。

en.t: He wrote many characters and drew many pictures for her to see, using them as copybooks for her writing and drawing practice.
Everything he wrote and drew was exquisitely beautiful.

units.source_text: 其中一张写的是一曲古歌：

en.t: On one of the sheets he had written an old poem:
Though I have never seen Musashino, even hearing its name makes it dear to me.

units.source_text: 只因生紫草，常把我心牵。”[\[29\]](#part1334.html#m29)

en.t: Only because the purple gromwell grows there, it is always drawing my heart toward it.”[\[29\]](#part1334.html#m29)

units.source_text: 写在紫色纸上，笔致特别秀丽。

en.t: It was written on purple paper, and the brushwork was especially elegant.

units.source_text: 紫儿拿起来看看，但见旁边又用稍小的字题着一首诗：

en.t: Zi'er picked it up and looked at it, and saw that another poem had been inscribed beside it in slightly smaller characters:
